text:
amy: Quick sync — final contingency runbook for tomorrow's webinar? want one-liner steps we can pin in the event doc.

sam: Yes. I made a short checklist, posting here. keeps ops clear during greenroom. :white_check_mark:

sam: 1) Primary Zoom (host account) + enable cloud recording (auto). 2) Local OBS backup recording on host laptop. 3) Fallback Zoom link (alternate account) pre-made. 4) Broadcast RTMP to private YouTube unlisted as a hot backup. 5) Post-event: combine cloud + local for highest quality.

julian: Add: start local OBS record 10m before go-time and label file with event id. also make sure mic fallback is tested.

maria: For leads: capture registration id in the Zoom registration pass-through param so we can map replay views to SFDC. if stream fallback used, make sure the registration landing page still captures email via querystring.

amy: good call. can we get exact Zoom settings we need to confirm? esp recording settings and co-hosts.

sam: Zoom settings to check (copy into settings page):
```
- Cloud recording: enabled, local recording allowed: host & co-hosts
- Record active speaker + gallery + shared screen
- Auto-delete cloud recordings: off (retain 30 days)
- Allow participants to join before host: off
- Alternative host: ops@redwood.ai
- Require registration: yes, manual approval off
```

sam: Also pre-create alt link: zoom.us/j/ALT-12345 (password: redwood123) — only share if primary fails.

julian: For RTMP backup: I'll spin up an unlisted YouTube stream and give the stream key to ops. make sure to set privacy to unlisted, and disable chat to avoid PII.

maria: Post-event flow (high level):
- upload final video to Vimeo for hosting, auto-generate captions
- create 3x clips (45s social, 2m highlight, 6m demo)
- transcript > S3 bucket -> run QA on speaker names
- email replay to registrants + 1st nurture email 48hrs later

amy: How do we route leads from 'replay watchers' vs 'live attendees'? want separate nurture tracks.

maria: Live attendees -> priority sales notify (sf push). Replay watchers -> drip 3-email nurture, tag as "replay_viewer". set SL to 2 views triggers lead qual.

sam: Quick automation notes: make sure registration form has hidden param `event_id=2026-03-22-wkshp`. that gets appended to links. sample capture: `https://redwood.ai/reg?event_id=2026-03-22-wkshp&ref=zoom`

julian: Ops-bot: can you set a reminder 30m before start to run the fallback checklist?

ops-bot: Reminder created — 30 minutes before 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC. :alarm_clock:

amy: Perfect. last thing — who's owner for uploading final asset + clipping? sam?

sam: I can take upload + clips, julian will verify captions, maria will queue the nurture emails. amy will sign off on final description/CTAs.

amy: Great. I'll pin this thread in the event doc and add the Zoom settings snippet. thanks team! :rocket:

maria: one more tiny note — privacy checkbox must include consent for marketing follow-up. we'll add it to the reg form this afternoon.

julian: tested mic fallback today — ok. label gear bag, bring spare USB mic. :+1:

sam: i'll also bring a spare laptop preloaded with OBS.

amy: Awesome. pinning now.
